function stamp17(ctx,key,x,y,w,h,rot=0,opacity=1,flip=false){

 if(!Number.isFinite(x+y+w+h))return false;

// Restores the exact Surf-Transparent DS crest animation from V35.12 (not the line replacement of V35.16).
function surf17(ctx,fx,t,a,now,scale){

 // The water grows from the attacker's location and continues through to the target.

window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){

 if(!im17.complete||!im17.naturalWidth)return typeof prev3517==='function'?prev3517(ctx,fx,now,e):false;

};

 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to, dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx);
 for(let i=0;i<13;i++){
   const q=CL((t-i*.045)/.72); if(q<=0) continue; const p=EZ(q), pt=MIX(from,to,p), size=(18+i%3*5)*sc;
   v353Draw(ctx,'ice'+(i%5),pt[0],pt[1],size,size,ang+i*.15,a*(.82-i*.04));
   if(i%2===0) shard(ctx,pt[0],pt[1],5*sc+i%2,ang+i*.4,'#d8f6ff',a*.55);
 }
 if(t>.56){
   const p=CL((t-.56)/.44);
   for(let i=0;i<9;i++){
     const theta=i*(Math.PI*2/9)+now*.008, rr=(8+p*(14+(i%3)*5))*sc;
     shard(ctx,to[0]+Math.cos(theta)*rr,to[1]+Math.sin(theta)*rr*.7,5*sc,theta,'#b8ecff',a*(.72-i*.05));
   }
 }
 return true;
}

function blizzard19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), to=fx.to;
 for(let i=0;i<20;i++){
   const q=CL((t-i*.02)/.88), x=to[0]-80*sc+q*160*sc+Math.sin(i+now*.01)*8*sc, y=to[1]-50*sc+(i%5)*18*sc+Math.cos(i+now*.013)*10*sc;
   if(q>0){
     v353Draw(ctx,'ice'+(i%5),x,y,(12+i%3*4)*sc,(12+i%3*4)*sc,now*.01+i,a*(.56-i*.018));
     if(i%3===0) circle(ctx,x,y,(2+i%2)*sc,'#f4ffff',a*.42);
   }
 }
 if(t>.60) for(let i=0;i<7;i++) ring(ctx,to[0],to[1],(14+i*7+(t-.60)*18)*sc,'#d7f6ff',1.8,a*(.40-i*.04),.82);
 return true;
}

function solarBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to;
 if(t<.34){
   const p=t/.34;
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
     const ang=i*(Math.PI*2/8)+now*.007, rr=(20+(1-p)*14)*sc;
     v353Draw(ctx,'energy'+(i%7),from[0]+Math.cos(ang)*rr,from[1]+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.7,14*sc,14*sc,ang,a*.72);
   }
   ring(ctx,from[0],from[1],(18+p*12)*sc,'#ffe96b',2.4,a*.62,.70);
   return true;
 }
 const p=EZ(CL((t-.28)/.72));
 v353Bezier(ctx,from,to,0,'#ffef77',14*sc,a*.55);
 v353Bezier(ctx,from,to,0,'#fffbd8',6*sc,a*.95);
 for(let i=0;i<10;i++){
   const q=CL((p-i*.05)); const pt=MIX(from,to,q);
   v353Draw(ctx,'energy'+(i%7),pt[0],pt[1],16*sc+q*10*sc,16*sc+q*10*sc,0,a*(.78-i*.05));
 }
 if(t>.62) v353Draw(ctx,'flash',to[0],to[1],42*sc,28*sc,0,a*.45);
 return true;
}

function sludgeBomb19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to;
 const dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)), nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;
 const p=EZ(CL((t-.04)/.58));
 const x=L(from[0],to[0],p), y=L(from[1],to[1],p)-Math.sin(Math.PI*p)*20*sc;
 // projétil roxo MUITO visível
 dot(ctx,x,y,16*sc,'#6f2b89',a*.96);
 dot(ctx,x+2*sc,y-2*sc,10*sc,'#d791ff',a*.64);
 for(let i=8;i>=0;i--){
   const q=CL(p-i*.06); const tx=L(from[0],to[0],q), ty=L(from[1],to[1],q)-Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*(12-i)*sc;
   const wob=Math.sin(now*.012+i*1.4)*(5+i*.45)*sc;
   dot(ctx,tx+nx*wob,ty+ny*wob*.45,(4+i*.8)*sc,i%2?'#c878f0':'#8f44b2',a*(.10+i*.07));
 }
 // explosão tóxica bem grande no alvo
 if(t>.40){
   const hit=CL((t-.40)/.60);
   puff(ctx,to[0],to[1]-2*sc,(24+hit*14)*sc,'#7e329d',a*.42);
   puff(ctx,to[0]-12*sc,to[1]+2*sc,(16+hit*10)*sc,'#5d1f6f',a*.34);
   puff(ctx,to[0]+14*sc,to[1]-6*sc,(14+hit*10)*sc,'#b56fe0',a*.30);
   for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
     const ang=i*(Math.PI*2/14)+now*.006, rr=(10+hit*(18+(i%3)*6))*sc;
     dot(ctx,to[0]+Math.cos(ang)*rr,to[1]-4*sc+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.55,5+(i%2)*2,'#cf8eff',a*(.50-i*.022));
   }
   for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
     const rise=CL(hit-i*.06); if(rise<=0) continue;
     dot(ctx,to[0]-12*sc+i*4.5*sc,to[1]+10*sc-rise*(24+i*4)*sc,4+(i%2),'#e3b9ff',a*(.34-i*.03));
   }
   ring(ctx,to[0],to[1],16*sc+hit*12*sc,'#e0a4ff',2.1,a*.28,.72);
  }
 return true;
}


function razorLeaf19(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=hitAlpha(fx,now), sc=scaleFor(e), from=fx.from,to=fx.to, dx=to[0]-from[0], dy=to[1]-from[1], ang=Math.atan2(dy,dx), len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)), nx=-dy/len, ny=dx/len;

}

window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
 try{
   if(!fx||!fx.kind) return typeof prevPaint3519==='function'?prevPaint3519(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
   v3520Stats.fx[fx.kind]=(v3520Stats.fx[fx.kind]||0)+1;
   const nm=NM((fx.move&&fx.move.name)||fx.name||'');
   // Preserve what the user approved: surf, water pulse, bubble beam, waterfall, shadow ball, flamethrower,
   // petal dance, fire blast, earthquake. Only Hydro Pump gets an upgrade.
   if(fx.kind==='hydropump' || /hydropump|hidrobomba|hidrocanhao/.test(nm)) return hydroStrong(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='bonemerang' || /bonemerang|ossobumerangue|osso bumerangue/.test(nm)) return (typeof drawBoneExclusive==='function'?drawBoneExclusive(ctx,{...fx,kind:'bonemerang'},now):false) || true;
   if(fx.kind==='boneclub' || /boneclub|clubdeosso|porretedeosso/.test(nm)) return (typeof drawBoneExclusive==='function'?drawBoneExclusive(ctx,{...fx,kind:'boneclub'},now):boneClub19(ctx,fx,now,e)) || true;
   if(fx.kind==='mud') return mud19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='earthpower') return earthPower19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='rockslide') return rockSlide19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='nightshade' || /nightshade|sombranoturna/.test(nm) || (/shadow/.test(nm) && !/shadowball|boladesombra/.test(nm))) return nightShade19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='psychic' || /confusion|confusao/.test(nm)) return psychic19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='icebeam') return iceBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='blizzard') return blizzard19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='solarbeam') return solarBeam19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='sludgebomb') return sludgeBomb19(ctx,fx,now,e);
   if(fx.kind==='razorleaf' || fx.kind==='vine') return razorLeaf19(ctx,fx,now,e);
 }catch(err){ console.error('V35.20 FX error', err); }
 return typeof prevPaint3519==='function'?prevPaint3519(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
};

/* V35.32 - BONEMERANG EMOJI: dedicated final render layer. Other moves untouched. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const moveNorm=v=>String(v||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 const isBone=fx=>!!fx&&(fx.kind==='bonemerang'||/bonemerang|ossobumerangue|ossobumerang/.test(moveNorm(fx.move?.name||fx.name)));
 // The original sprite/canvas pipelines overlap. For Bonemerang only,
 // prevent earlier versions from drawing an invisible/conflicting bone.
 const previousPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
 window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
  if(isBone(fx))return true;
  return typeof previousPainter==='function'?previousPainter(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
 };
 const previousDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let boneFrames=0,lastX=0,lastY=0,lastT=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
  previousDraw.call(this,now);
  if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx||!Array.isArray(this.v359Attacks))return;
  const ctx=this.ctx;
  const ts=Number.isFinite(now)?now:performance.now();
  for(const fx of this.v359Attacks){
   if(!isBone(fx)||fx.battle!==battle||!fx.from||!fx.to)continue;
   const duration=Math.max(1,fx.duration||((fx.end||ts)-(fx.at||ts))||1120);
   const t=(ts-fx.at)/duration;
   if(t<0||t>1)continue;
   let p=t<=.5?t/.5:(1-t)/.5;
   p=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,p));
   p=p*p*(3-2*p);
   const x=fx.from[0]+(fx.to[0]-fx.from[0])*p;
   const y=fx.from[1]+(fx.to[1]-fx.from[1])*p-Math.sin(Math.PI*p)*20;
   const fontSize=Math.max(16,Math.min(24,(this.h||360)*.058));
   ctx.save();
   ctx.translate(x,y);
   ctx.rotate((t<=.5?1:-1)*t*Math.PI*4);
   ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';
   ctx.font=fontSize+'px "Noto Color Emoji","Apple Color Emoji","Segoe UI Emoji",sans-serif';
   ctx.globalAlpha=Math.min(1,(t+.03)*8,(1.03-t)*8);
   ctx.shadowColor='#fff0b2';ctx.shadowBlur=2;
   ctx.fillText('🦴',0,0);
   ctx.restore();
   boneFrames++; lastX=x;lastY=y;lastT=t;
  }
 };
 function showVersion(){
  const label=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');
  if(label)label.textContent='V35.34 · 🦴 BONEMERANG MENOR';
  const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');
  if(home)home.textContent='V35.34';
  document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.34 — Bonemerang Menor 🦴';
 }
 const prevRender=render;
 render=function(){const out=prevRender.apply(this,arguments);showVersion();return out;};
 showVersion();
 window.PokemonTorreVersion='V35.34';
 window.PokemonTorreV3534Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.34',bonemerangFrames:boneFrames,lastX,lastY,lastT,activeBonemerang:!!engine?.v359Attacks?.some(isBone),font:'smallest'});
})();


/* V35.35 - Afinidade de arena e indicador de ATK+ por clima. Isolado dos efeitos visuais de golpes. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const V='V35.35';
 const ARENA_ATTACK=0.12;
 const WEATHER_BONUSES={rain:{water:1.20},sun:{fire:1.20},sand:{rock:1.12,ground:1.12},storm:{electric:1.12},fog:{ghost:1.10,poison:1.10},snow:{ice:1.12},hail:{ice:1.12},volcano:{fire:1.20}};
 const TYPE_SYMBOL={water:'💧',fire:'🔥',electric:'⚡',grass:'🌿',ground:'⛰',rock:'🪨',poison:'☣',psychic:'🔮',ghost:'👻',ice:'❄',fighting:'🥊',flying:'🪶',dragon:'🐉',normal:'✦',bug:'🐛',dark:'🌑',steel:'⚙',fairy:'✨'};
 const keyName=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 function gymType(){
  if(!battle?.active)return null;
  // O cenário é o tipo visual do ginásio em que a luta está acontecendo.
  const idx=Number.isInteger(battle.v359Gym)?battle.v359Gym:save.gym;
  return GYMS[Math.max(0,Math.min(GYMS.length-1,idx))]?.type||null;
 }
 function monHasType(mon,type){const data=mon&&D[mon.id];return !!type&&!!data&&(data.type===type||data.type2===type);}
 function terrainBonus(mon){return monHasType(mon,gymType())?ARENA_ATTACK:0;}
 function weatherDetail(mon){
  if(!battle?.active||!mon)return [];
  const code=String(battle.v32Weather||'clear').toLowerCase();
  const boosts=WEATHER_BONUSES[code];if(!boosts)return [];
  return Object.entries(boosts)
   .filter(([type,mult])=>monHasType(mon,type)&&mult>1)
   .map(([type,mult])=>({type,amount:Math.round((mult-1)*100),name:TYPE_NAME[type]||type,icon:TYPE_SYMBOL[type]||'✦',weather:code}));
 }
 const V3548_BONUS_STATE={ally:{until:0,lines:[]},enemy:{until:0,lines:[]},bottomUntil:0,bottomText:''};
 function v3548MarkBonus(attacker){
  if(!battle?.active||!attacker)return;
  const terrain=terrainBonus(attacker),weather=weatherDetail(attacker);
  const lines=[];
  if(terrain)lines.push({text:'ATK +12% · ARENA',color:'#a8f5c4'});
  if(weather.length){const main=weather[0];lines.push({text:'ATK +'+main.amount+'% · '+main.icon+' '+String(main.name||'').toUpperCase(),color:'#ffe29e'});}
  if(!lines.length)return;
  const side=(attacker===current()||attacker===battle?.v31Duo?.ally)?'ally':'enemy';
  const until=performance.now()+1150;
  V3548_BONUS_STATE[side]={until,lines};
  if(side==='ally'){V3548_BONUS_STATE.bottomUntil=until;V3548_BONUS_STATE.bottomText=lines.map(l=>l.text).join(' · ');}
 }
 const previousDamage3535=damage;
 damage=function(attacker,defender,type,power){
  const result=previousDamage3535(attacker,defender,type,power);
  if(!result||!result.hit||!battle?.active||!attacker)return result;
  const bonus=terrainBonus(attacker);
  if(bonus)result.hit=Math.max(1,Math.round(result.hit*(1+bonus)));
  v3548MarkBonus(attacker);
  return result;
 };
 function statsFor(mon){return {arena:gymType(),terrain:terrainBonus(mon),weather:weatherDetail(mon),weatherCode:battle?.v32Weather||'clear',type:D[mon?.id]?.type||''};}
 const prevDraw3535=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 function paintBuff(ctx,x,y,text,color){
  ctx.save();
  const fontSize=Math.max(7,Math.min(9,(engine?.h||360)*.019));
  ctx.font='800 '+fontSize+'px system-ui, sans-serif';
  const textWidth=ctx.measureText(text).width;
  const w=textWidth+10,h=fontSize+5;
  const xx=Math.max(w/2+3,Math.min((engine?.w||9999)-w/2-3,x));
  ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,21,30,0.87)';
  ctx.strokeStyle='rgba(158,214,191,0.65)';
  ctx.lineWidth=.8;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(xx-w/2,y-h/2,w,h,4);ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();
  ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.textBaseline='middle';ctx.fillText(text,xx,y+0.5);
  ctx.restore();
 }
 function drawIndicators(e){
  if(!battle?.active||!e.ctx)return;
  const ctx=e.ctx,now=performance.now();
  const actors={ally:e.player,enemy:e.enemy};
  for(const side of ['ally','enemy']){
   const state=V3548_BONUS_STATE[side],pos=actors[side];
   if(!state||!pos||now>state.until||!state.lines?.length)continue;
   const x=pos.x,top=Math.max(28,pos.y-e.h*.205);
   state.lines.forEach((line,i)=>paintBuff(ctx,x,top+(i*14),line.text,line.color));

  const ret=prevDraw3535.call(this,now);

 // Rain Dance/Sunny Day/Sandstorm already change v32Weather in the combat engine.

  const labels={rain:'🌧 Chuva',sun:'☀ Sol forte',sand:'🌪 Areia',storm:'⛈ Tempestade',fog:'🌫 Névoa',snow:'❄ Neve',hail:'🌨 Granizo',volcano:'🌋 Calor vulcânico'};
  chip.textContent=labels[code]||code.toUpperCase();

/* V35.38 - flying refinement + smaller ATK labels. Baseline V35.35 protected. */
(function(){

const normalize=v=>String(v||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
function flyingKind(s){

const v3545Time=(fx,now)=>{const duration=Math.max(1,fx.duration||fx.end-fx.at||800),t=v3545Clamp((now-fx.at)/duration);return [t,v3545Clamp(Math.min(t*8,(1-t)*8))];};
const v3545Scale=e=>Math.max(.8,Math.min(1.2,(e?.h||360)/480));
function v3545Line(ctx,pts,c,w,a){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=c;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.lineJoin='round';ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(pts[0][0],pts[0][1]);for(const p of pts.slice(1))ctx.lineTo(p[0],p[1]);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function v3545Oval(ctx,x,y,rx,ry,color,w,a){ctx.save();ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=w;ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,Math.max(1,rx),Math.max(1,ry),0,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
function v3545Chip(ctx,x,y,r,rot,a,color){ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=v3545Clamp(a);ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(rot);ctx.fillStyle=color;ctx.strokeStyle='#e0bb86';ctx.lineWidth=.65;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-r,-r*.5);ctx.lineTo(-r*.3,-r);ctx.lineTo(r*.8,-r*.7);ctx.lineTo(r,r*.5);ctx.lineTo(-r*.2,r);ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();}
// Module placeholders replaced in build
function v3545Earthquake(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now), sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const from=fx.from||[0,0],to=fx.to||from;
 const cx=(from[0]+to[0])/2,cy=(from[1]+to[1])/2+e.h*.032, p=v3545Ease(t);
 // Tremor de área, com rachaduras ramificadas e ondas se propagando pelo piso.
 for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
  const rr=(20+j*13+p*(62+j*9))*sc;
  v3545Oval(ctx,cx,cy,rr,rr*.55,j%2?'#edce97':'#9f7949',2.4,a*(.42-j*.058));
 }
 for(let j=0;j<12;j++){
  const ang=j*Math.PI*2/12+.14*Math.sin(now*.006+j),rr=(22+p*(58+(j%3)*18))*sc;
  const ox=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr*.21,oy=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.11;
  const mx=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr*.66, my=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.40;
  const ex=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr,ey=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.58;
  v3545Line(ctx,[[ox,oy],[mx+Math.sin(j*3)*8*sc,my],[ex,ey]],j%2?'#e4c58d':'#4a3025',2.5*sc,a*.68);
  if(j%2===0)v3545Line(ctx,[[mx,my],[mx+Math.cos(ang+.6)*24*sc,my+Math.sin(ang+.6)*14*sc]],'#cbab77',1.5*sc,a*.5);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<17;j++){
   const ang=j*2.399+now*.0016,rr=(12+p*(28+j%5*9))*sc;
   const x=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr,y=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.56-Math.sin(Math.PI*t)*(7+j%3*2)*sc;
   v3545Chip(ctx,x,y,2.3+(j%3)*1.0,ang,a*(.55-j*.017),'#95714b');
 }
}

function v3545Abalo(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now),sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const from=fx.from||[0,0],to=fx.to||from;
 const dx=to[0]-from[0],dy=to[1]-from[1],len=Math.max(1,Math.hypot(dx,dy)),ux=dx/len,uy=dy/len,nx=-uy,ny=ux;
 const p=v3545Ease(Math.min(1,t/.72));
 const pts=[];
 for(let i=0;i<=10;i++){
   const q=(i/10)*p;
   const bx=from[0]+dx*q, by=from[1]+dy*q;
   const zig=((i%2)?1:-1)*(4+8*q)*sc + Math.sin(now*.008+i*.6)*2.2*sc;
   pts.push([bx+nx*zig, by+ny*zig*.42]);
 }
 v3545Line(ctx,pts,'#40281b',6.8*sc,a*.95);
 v3545Line(ctx,pts,'#c59a64',2.2*sc,a*.70);
 for(let i=1;i<pts.length-1;i++){
   const x=pts[i][0], y=pts[i][1], dir=(i%2)?1:-1;
   const l=(7+(i%3)*4+p*8)*sc;
   v3545Line(ctx,[[x,y],[x+nx*l*dir,y+ny*l*.7*dir]], i%2?'#5a3927':'#dfb985', i%2?2.3*sc:1.2*sc, a*(.55-i*.03));
   if(i%2===0) v3545Chip(ctx,x+nx*l*dir,y+ny*l*.7*dir,3.4*sc,.3+i,a*.44,'#8c6540');
 }
 for(let i=0;i<14;i++){
   const q=Math.max(0,p-i*.06); if(q<=0) continue;
   const bx=from[0]+dx*q, by=from[1]+dy*q;
   const off=((i%2)?1:-1)*(10+(i%4)*4)*sc;
   const lift=Math.sin(Math.PI*q)*(10+(i%3)*4)*sc;
   v3545Chip(ctx,bx+nx*off,by+ny*off*.25-lift,2.8+(i%3)*.8,.2+i,a*(.42-i*.015),i%2?'#bc9261':'#6f5035');
 }
 if(t>.42){
   const q=v3545Ease((t-.42)/.58),cx=to[0],cy=to[1]+3*sc;
   v3545Oval(ctx,cx,cy,(18+q*34)*sc,(9+q*16)*sc,'#f0cf9c',2.6,a*.62);
   for(let i=0;i<12;i++){
     const ang=i*Math.PI*2/12+now*.003,rr=(10+q*(18+(i%3)*6))*sc;
     const px=cx+Math.cos(ang)*rr, py=cy+Math.sin(ang)*rr*.54-q*(6+(i%2)*3)*sc;
     v3545Chip(ctx,px,py,2.8+(i%3)*.8,ang,a*(.58-i*.02),i%2?'#b88e5f':'#705034');
   }
   for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
     const off=(-2+i)*12*sc, h=(12+q*22+(i%2)*7)*sc;
     v3545Line(ctx,[[cx+off,cy+4*sc],[cx+off*1.02,cy-h],[cx+off+3*sc,cy+1*sc]],'#5c3d29',3.6*sc,a*.55);
     v3545Line(ctx,[[cx+off,cy+4*sc],[cx+off*1.02,cy-h],[cx+off+3*sc,cy+1*sc]],'#d3ae78',1.2*sc,a*.34);
   }
 }
}

function v3545Tremor(ctx,fx,now,e){
 const [t,a]=v3545Time(fx,now),sc=v3545Scale(e);
 const to=fx.to||[0,0],x=to[0],y=to[1]+6*sc;
 // Tremor localizado: pequenos pulsos circulares e seixos pulando no solo.
 for(let j=0;j<5;j++){
  const f=(t-j*.14);
  if(f<0||f>1)continue;
  const p=v3545Ease(f),r=(11+p*31)*sc;
  v3545Oval(ctx,x,y,r,r*.38,j%2?'#eed6a8':'#917252',2.0,a*(1-p)*.65);
 }
 for(let j=0;j<9;j++){
  const f=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(t-j*.065)*1.5));if(!f)continue;
  const th=j*2.399,r=(7+(j%3)*8)*sc;
  const bx=x+Math.cos(th)*r,by=y+Math.sin(th)*r*.52-Math.sin(f*Math.PI)*12*sc;
  v3545Chip(ctx,bx,by,2.4+(j%3)*.75,th,a*(.4-j*.015),'#b49a73');
 }
}

const v3545PreviousPainter=window.PokemonTorreV360Paint;
let v3545Hits={earthquake:0,abalo:0,tremor:0};
window.PokemonTorreV360Paint=function(ctx,fx,now,e){
 if(fx?.from&&fx?.to){
   const name=v3545Normalize(fx.move?.name||fx.name);
   // Cada golpe usa desenho próprio, independente do kind genérico 'earthpower'.
   if(/earthquake|terremoto/.test(name)){v3545Earthquake(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.earthquake++;return true;}
   if(/abaloterrestre/.test(name)){v3545Abalo(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.abalo++;return true;}
   if(/tremor/.test(name)){v3545Tremor(ctx,fx,now,e);v3545Hits.tremor++;return true;}
 }
 return typeof v3545PreviousPainter==='function'?v3545PreviousPainter(ctx,fx,now,e):false;
};
// Earthquake é adicionado ao catálogo no bloco V34, onde v32Catalogue existe.
// Aplicar APENAS paleta de cores, por cima da cadeia existente de animação.
// Não substitui frames nem sprites Idle/Walk/Attack/Hurt/Faint.
const v3545OldDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
let v3545ShinyDraws=0;
const v3552SpriteBuffers=new WeakMap();
let v3552StarFrames=0, v3552TintFrames=0;
function v3552GetLayer(e){
  let l=v3552SpriteBuffers.get(e);
  if(!l){ const canvas=document.createElement('canvas');canvas.width=176;canvas.height=176;l={canvas,ctx:canvas.getContext('2d',{alpha:true})};v3552SpriteBuffers.set(e,l); }
  return l;
}
function v3552Star(ctx,x,y,r,alpha,phase){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,alpha));ctx.fillStyle='#ffe978';ctx.strokeStyle='#fff5b8';ctx.lineWidth=1;
 ctx.shadowColor='#ffdf67';ctx.shadowBlur=3;
 ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(phase);
 ctx.beginPath();
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){const angle=i*Math.PI/4-Math.PI/2, radius=i%2===0?r:r*.35;const xx=Math.cos(angle)*radius,yy=Math.sin(angle)*radius;if(!i)ctx.moveTo(xx,yy);else ctx.lineTo(xx,yy);}
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function v3555ShinyTones(id){
 switch(Number(id)){
  // Apenas source-atop para evitar qualquer halo/quadrado do canvas ao redor do sprite.
  case 18:return [['rgba(198,154,92,0.44)','source-atop'],['rgba(244,226,185,0.16)','source-atop']]; // Pidgeot shiny: dourado fiel e visível
  case 6:return [['rgba(63,68,74,0.44)','source-atop'],['rgba(115,214,194,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Charizard shiny escuro
  case 94:return [['rgba(146,156,214,0.28)','source-atop'],['rgba(236,223,255,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Gengar mais claro
  case 68:return [['rgba(150,190,124,0.28)','source-atop'],['rgba(228,244,214,0.10)','source-atop']]; // Machamp verde
  case 62:return [['rgba(89,98,186,0.30)','source-atop'],['rgba(198,219,255,0.08)','source-atop']]; // Poliwrath azul
  case 105:return [['rgba(132,181,101,0.30)','source-atop'],['rgba(232,225,182,0.09)','source-atop']]; // Marowak esverdeado
  default:return [['rgba(225,199,108,0.26)','source-atop'],['rgba(255,239,180,0.08)','source-atop']];
 }
}
function v3555ApplyShinyTint(ctx,w,h,id){
 const tones=v3555ShinyTones(id);
 for(const [fill,mode] of tones){ctx.save();ctx.globalCompositeOperation=mode||'source-atop';ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fillRect(0,0,w,h);ctx.restore();}
}
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,isEnemy,now){
 const monRef=isEnemy?foe():current();
 if(!monRef?.shiny||monRef.id!==id||!this.ctx||!actor) return v3545OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const main=this.ctx, layer=v3552GetLayer(this), ctx=layer.ctx;
 const bw=layer.canvas.width,bh=layer.canvas.height;
 ctx.save();ctx.setTransform(1,0,0,1,0,0);ctx.clearRect(0,0,bw,bh);
 // Renderiza SOMENTE o Pokemon numa camada transparente: a arena nao pode ser tingida.
 ctx.translate(bw/2-actor.x,bh/2-actor.y);
 this.ctx=ctx;
 let result;
 try{result=v3545OldDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);}finally{this.ctx=main;ctx.restore();}
 v3555ApplyShinyTint(ctx,bw,bh,id);
 main.save();main.drawImage(layer.canvas,actor.x-bw/2,actor.y-bh/2);main.restore();
 v3552TintFrames++;
 // Estrelas vetoriais so na entrada, somem depois.
 if(battle?.active){
  const keyId=isEnemy?'v3552FoeId':'v3552AllyId';
  const keyTime=isEnemy?'v3552FoeUntil':'v3552AllyUntil';
  if(battle[keyId]!==monRef){battle[keyId]=monRef;battle[keyTime]=now+2200;}
  const rem=Math.max(0,(battle[keyTime]||0)-now);
  if(rem>0){
    const k=1-rem/2200,fade=Math.min(1,rem/330)*Math.min(1,(k+.04)*6);
    const r=(this.h||500)/500,spread=(13+9*Math.sin(k*Math.PI))*r;
    const xx=actor.x,yy=actor.y-(this.h||500)*.11;
    for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
      const a=i*Math.PI*2/7+now*.003,drift=spread*(.70+(i%3)*.12);
      v3552Star(main,xx+Math.cos(a)*drift,yy+Math.sin(a)*drift*.84, (i%3===0?5.5:3.7)*r,fade*(.55+(i%2)*.17),a+now*.003);
    }
    v3552StarFrames++;
  }
 }
 v3545ShinyDraws++;
 return result;
};

// V35.54: inimigos Lutador fisicos tambem so acertam corpo a corpo.
const v3554PreviousHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(side,type,power){
  const rangedFighting=(side==='enemy'&&(this.v359Attacks||[]).some(fx=>fx.end>performance.now()&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&/aurasphere|esferaaura|focusblast|vacuumwave|ondadevacuo/.test(String(fx.move?.name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[̀-ͯ]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,''))));
  if(type==='fighting'&&!rangedFighting&&battle?.active&&this.player&&this.enemy){
    const d=Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.enemy.x,this.player.y-this.enemy.y);
    if(d>Math.max(56,this.h*.19)){
      this.v3554Misses=(this.v3554Misses||0)+1;
      // Qualquer dano Lutador fora do alcance e ignorado; Aura Sphere e especial
      // sera tratado pelo sistema de golpes nomeados se presente.
      return;
    }
  }
  return v3554PreviousHit.call(this,side,type,power);
};
const v3554PreviousUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
  const enemyFighting=battle?.active&&D[foe()?.id]?.type==='fighting';
  const far=enemyFighting&&this.player&&this.enemy&&Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.enemy.x,this.player.y-this.enemy.y)>Math.max(56,this.h*.19);
  if(far){
    // Nao permite ataque remoto de IA para quem usa socos/chutes.
    if(this.telegraph?.from==='enemy'&&this.telegraph.type==='fighting')this.telegraph=null;
    if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD))this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.24,this.enemyAttackCD);
  }
  const result=v3554PreviousUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
  if(far&&Array.isArray(this.projectiles))this.projectiles=this.projectiles.filter(x=>!(x.from==='enemy'&&x.type==='fighting'));
  return result;
};
window.PokemonTorreV3554Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.57',starDurationMs:2200,shinyColor:'species-faithful-animated',meleeRangePx:Math.max(56,(engine?.h||720)*.19),outOfReach:engine?.v3554OutOfReach||0,misses:engine?.v3554Misses||0,allyShiny:!!current()?.shiny,starRemaining:Math.max(0,(battle?.v3552AllyUntil||0)-performance.now())});
window.PokemonTorreV3552Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.52',tintedFrames:v3552TintFrames,starFrames:v3552StarFrames,allyShiny:!!current()?.shiny,starRemaining:Math.max(0,(battle?.v3552AllyUntil||0)-performance.now())});

const v3545OldRender=render;
function v3545Version(){
 const label=document.getElementById('v30VersionTag');if(label)label.textContent='V35.57 · SHINY FIEL SEM HALO';
 const home=document.getElementById('v3520VersionHome');if(home)home.textContent='V35.57';
 document.title='Pokémon Torre V35.57 — Shiny fiel sem halo';
}

v3545Version();window.PokemonTorreVersion='V35.57';
const v3548RenderPrev=renderBattle;
renderBattle=function(){
 const ret=v3548RenderPrev.apply(this,arguments);

 if(ally){ally.querySelectorAll('.v31Status').forEach(n=>n.remove()); if(current()?.shiny && !ally.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag')) ally.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
 if(enemy){enemy.querySelectorAll('.v31Status').forEach(n=>n.remove()); if(foe()?.shiny && !enemy.querySelector('.v301ShinyFlag')) enemy.insertAdjacentHTML('beforeend','<span class="v301ShinyFlag">✦ SHINY</span>');}
 return ret;
};
const v3548UpdateFastPrev=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
 const ret=v3548UpdateFastPrev.call(this,dt,now);
 if(battle?.active&&!battle.paused){
  if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD))this.enemyAttackCD=Math.min(this.enemyAttackCD,1.18);
  const d=battle.v31Duo;
  if(d&&Number.isFinite(d.clockEnemy))d.clockEnemy=Math.min(d.clockEnemy,1.55);
 }
 return ret;
};
window.PokemonTorreV3545Diagnostics=()=>({version:'35.52',hitCounts:{...v3545Hits},shinyDraws:v3545ShinyDraws,shiny:!!current()?.shiny,marowakMoveList:'Earthquake disponível em catálogo V34'});
})();

/* INICIO 01_shiny_animado.js */
/* V35.58: sprites shiny por especie, sem filtros quadrados no canvas */
const SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES = {"18":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"6":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"94":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"105":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"62":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"},"68":{"Idle":"data:image/png;base64,","Walk":"data:image/png;base64,","Attack":"data:image/png;base64,","Hurt":"data:image/png;base64,","Portrait":"data:image/png;base64,"}};

const shinySpriteCache = Object.create(null);
let shinyProtectedFrames=0,shinyProtectedStars=0;
const shinyActualFrames={Idle:0,Walk:0,Attack:0,Hurt:0};
function shinyProtectedImages(id){
 id=Number(id);
 if(!SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[id])return null;
 if(shinySpriteCache[id])return shinySpriteCache[id];
 const out={};
 for(const action of ['Idle','Walk','Attack','Hurt']){
   const image=new Image();image.decoding='async';image.src=SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[id][action];out[action]=image;
 }
 return (shinySpriteCache[id]=out);
}
const shinyPreviousDrawMon=BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon;
// Desenho independente para shiny; não há sobrescrita de sheets a cada frame.
// Assim garantimos que cada animação percorre seus próprios quadros e não volta ao Idle.
function shinyVectorStar(ctx,x,y,r,alpha,phase){
 ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,alpha));ctx.fillStyle='#ffe98b';
 ctx.strokeStyle='#fff9d6';ctx.lineWidth=.8;ctx.shadowColor='#ffe3a7';ctx.shadowBlur=2;
 ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.rotate(phase);ctx.beginPath();
 for(let i=0;i<8;i++){
   const a=i*Math.PI/4-Math.PI/2,rr=i%2===0?r:r*.36;
   const px=Math.cos(a)*rr,py=Math.sin(a)*rr;
   if(i===0)ctx.moveTo(px,py);else ctx.lineTo(px,py);
 }
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fill();ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
}
function shinySelectAction(actor,e,isEnemy,id){
 if((actor.flash||0)>0)return 'Hurt';
 if((e.attackActs?.[isEnemy?'enemy':'player']||0)>e.time)return 'Attack';
 let vx=actor.x-(actor.v3559LastX??actor.x),vy=actor.y-(actor.v3559LastY??actor.y);
 const moving=Math.hypot(vx,vy)>.38 || (!isEnemy && Math.hypot(e.input?.dx||0,e.input?.dy||0)>.12);
 actor.v3559LastX=actor.x;actor.v3559LastY=actor.y;
 return moving?'Walk':'Idle';
}
function shinyBlitFrame(ctx,img,action,actor,foeActor,engine,now){
 const frames=Math.max(1,Math.floor(img.naturalWidth/img.naturalHeight));
 if(actor.v3559Action!==action || actor.v3559Species!==engine.v3559CurrentId){
   actor.v3559Action=action;
   actor.v3559Species=engine.v3559CurrentId;
   actor.v3559ActionAt=now;
 }
 const elapsed=Math.max(0,now-(actor.v3559ActionAt||now));
 const frameDuration=action==='Walk'?88:action==='Attack'?Math.max(28,460/frames):action==='Hurt'?115:130;
 const index=(action==='Idle'||action==='Walk')?
   Math.floor(elapsed/frameDuration)%frames:Math.min(frames-1,Math.floor(elapsed/frameDuration));
 // O retângulo é recortado APENAS dos pixels do quadro; fundo transparente intacto.
 let crop;
 if(typeof v19FrameBounds==='function')crop=v19FrameBounds(img,index*img.naturalHeight,0,img.naturalHeight,img.naturalHeight);
 else crop={x:index*img.naturalHeight,y:0,w:img.naturalHeight,h:img.naturalHeight};
 const height=(engine.h||600)*(engine.v3559EnemyFlag?.079:.084);
 const width=height*Math.min(1.45,crop.w/Math.max(1,crop.h));
 const target=foeActor||actor;
 const towardX=(target.x-actor.x)||1;
 const mirror=towardX<0;
 let dx=0,dy=0;
 const bob=Math.sin(now*.009)*((action==='Idle'?2.1:1.0)*(engine.h||600)/600);
 if(action==='Walk')dy-=Math.abs(Math.sin(now*.024))*2.4*(engine.h||600)/600;
 if(action==='Attack'){
   const t=Math.min(1,elapsed/460);
   const advance=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*9*(engine.h||600)/600;
   dx+=Math.sign(towardX)*advance;
   dy-=Math.sin(t*Math.PI)*3;
 }
 if(action==='Hurt')dx+=Math.sin(now*.08)*2.6;
 ctx.save();
 ctx.globalAlpha=actor.inv>0&&Math.floor(now/80)%2===0?.68:1;
 ctx.translate(actor.x+dx,actor.y+dy+bob);
 if(mirror)ctx.scale(-1,1);
 if(action==='Idle')ctx.rotate(Math.sin(now*.006)*.025);
 ctx.imageSmoothingEnabled=false;
 ctx.drawImage(img,crop.x,crop.y,crop.w,crop.h,-width/2,-height*.64,width,height);
 ctx.restore();
 shinyActualFrames[action]++;
 engine.v3559ShinyLast={id:engine.v3559CurrentId,side:engine.v3559EnemyFlag?'enemy':'ally',action,frame:index,frameCount:frames,durationMs:frameDuration,now};
 return index;
}
BattleEngine.prototype.drawMon=function(actor,id,isEnemy,now){
 const mon=isEnemy?foe():current(),entry=this.assets?.get(id);
 if(!mon?.shiny || !entry || !actor || !this.ctx)return shinyPreviousDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const imgs=shinyProtectedImages(id);
 if(!imgs?.Idle?.complete || !imgs.Idle.naturalHeight)return shinyPreviousDrawMon.call(this,actor,id,isEnemy,now);
 const action=shinySelectAction(actor,this,isEnemy,id);
 const img=(imgs[action]?.complete&&imgs[action]?.naturalHeight)?imgs[action]:imgs.Idle;
 const ctx=this.ctx;
 this.v3559CurrentId=id;this.v3559EnemyFlag=isEnemy;
 shinyBlitFrame(ctx,img,action,actor,isEnemy?this.player:this.enemy,this,now);
 shinyProtectedFrames++;
 // Proteção e flash mantidos sem alterar a animação original do sprite.
 if(actor.guard>0){
  ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=.55;ctx.strokeStyle='#a5f7ff';ctx.lineWidth=2;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(actor.x,actor.y-(this.h||600)*.05,(this.h||600)*.052,0,Math.PI*2);ctx.stroke();ctx.restore();
 }
 // Estrelas APENAS por 2,2 segundos após entrada/switch, nunca num loop infinito.
 if(battle?.active){
    const idField=isEnemy?'v3559EnemyIdentity':'v3559PlayerIdentity';
    const untilField=isEnemy?'v3559EnemyEntryUntil':'v3559PlayerEntryUntil';
    if(battle[idField]!==mon){battle[idField]=mon;battle[untilField]=now+2200;}
    const rem=Math.max(0,(battle[untilField]||0)-now);
    if(rem>0){
      const progress=1-rem/2200,fade=Math.min(1,rem/340)*Math.min(1,(progress+.03)*6);
      const sc=(this.h||500)/500, spread=(14+10*Math.sin(progress*Math.PI))*sc;
      const cx=actor.x,cy=actor.y-(this.h||500)*.105;
      for(let i=0;i<7;i++){
        const a=i*Math.PI*2/7+now*.003;
        shinyVectorStar(ctx,cx+Math.cos(a)*spread,cy+Math.sin(a)*spread*.84,(i%3===0?5:3.3)*sc,fade*(.56+(i%2)*.12),a+now*.003);
      }
      shinyProtectedStars++;
    }
 }
 return true;
};
function shinyProtectedPortraits(){
 document.querySelectorAll('.moncard').forEach((card,i)=>{
   const mon=(save?.team||[])[i],pic=card.querySelector('.spritewrap img.sprite');
   const uri=mon?.shiny?SHINY_PROTEGIDO_SPRITES[mon.id]?.Portrait:null;

}

/* V35.58: inteligencia para lutadores e impactos fisicos, sem editar sprites/efeitos de golpes aprovados */
(function(){
 const previousUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const res=previousUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!battle?.active||battle.paused||!this.enemy||!this.player)return res;
   const mon=foe(),inf=D[mon?.id];
   if(!inf)return res;
   const fighting=(inf.type==='fighting'||inf.type2==='fighting');
   // Adversarios lutadores aproximam-se para poder acertar, sem teleporte.
   if(fighting){
     const dx=this.player.x-this.enemy.x,dy=this.player.y-this.enemy.y;
     const dist=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,ideal=Math.max(56,this.h*.18);
     if(dist>ideal+3){
       const advance=Math.min(dist-ideal,(this.h*.25)*Math.min(dt,.04));
       this.enemy.x+=dx/dist*advance;
       this.enemy.y+=dy/dist*advance;
       if(typeof this.collideRocks==='function')this.collideRocks(this.enemy);
       if(typeof this.bounds==='function')this.bounds(this.enemy);
     }
   }
   return res;
 };
 const previousDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=previousDraw.call(this,now);
   if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const ctx=this.ctx, effects=this.v359Attacks||[];
   const recent=effects.findLast?.(fx=>fx&&fx.kind==='contact'&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&now>=fx.at&&now<fx.at+fx.duration)
     || [...effects].reverse().find(fx=>fx&&fx.kind==='contact'&&fx.move?.type==='fighting'&&now>=fx.at&&now<fx.at+fx.duration);
   if(!recent)return result;
   const progress=(now-recent.at)/Math.max(1,recent.duration);
   if(progress<.25||progress>.76)return result;
   const fade=Math.max(0,Math.sin(Math.PI*(progress-.25)/.51));
   const tx=recent.to?.[0]||this.enemy.x,ty=recent.to?.[1]||this.enemy.y;
   ctx.save();ctx.globalAlpha=fade*.76;ctx.translate(tx,ty);
   for(let i=0;i<6;i++){
     const ang=i*Math.PI/3+now*.002,rad=(9+fade*16)*(this.h/560);
     ctx.strokeStyle=i%2?'#ffe5b9':'#e49e78';ctx.lineWidth=(i%2?1.8:2.4)*(this.h/560);
     ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(Math.cos(ang)*rad*.55,Math.sin(ang)*rad*.55);
     ctx.lineTo(Math.cos(ang)*rad,Math.sin(ang)*rad);ctx.stroke();
   }
   ctx.restore();
   return result;
 };
})();

   }

   if(badges[0]){badges[0].textContent=V;badges[0].style.cssText='font-size:12px;color:#b3fff2;padding:3px 8px;margin-left:8px;border:1px solid #77c4bc;border-radius:8px;display:inline-block;';}

})();

/* V35.60 — IA: combate justo, perseguicao fisica, esquivas com cooldown, variacao por chefe. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 let decisions=0,dodges=0,retreats=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const alive=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused;
   const foeBefore=alive?foe():null;
   const previousEnemy=alive&&this.enemy?{x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y}:null;
   const result=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!alive||!battle?.active||!foeBefore||!this.enemy||!this.player)return result;
   const stats=D[foe()?.id];if(!stats)return result;
   const boss=(!battle.wild)&&(battle.v32Mode==='tower'&&battle.v32Floor%5===0 || /chefe|campe[aã]o|l[ií]der|blue|rival/i.test(battle.label||''));
   const isFighter=stats.type==='fighting'||stats.type2==='fighting';
   const dist=Math.hypot(this.enemy.x-this.player.x,this.enemy.y-this.player.y)||1;
   // Permite decisoes mais frequentes sem zerar o cooldown a cada quadro.
   if(Number.isFinite(this.enemyAttackCD)&&this.enemyAttackCD>0){
      const cap=boss?1.48:(battle.wild?2.10:1.78);
      this.enemyAttackCD=Math.min(cap,this.enemyAttackCD);
   }
   if(!this.v3560AiTick||now>=this.v3560AiTick){
      this.v3560AiTick=now+(boss?410:620);decisions++;
      const hp=(foe()?.hp||0)/Math.max(1,foe()?.maxHp||1);
      if(!isFighter && hp<.25 && dist<this.h*.26 && !this.telegraph){
        const dx=(this.enemy.x-this.player.x)/dist,dy=(this.enemy.y-this.player.y)/dist;
        this.enemy.x+=dx*this.h*.042;this.enemy.y+=dy*this.h*.042;
        this.collideRocks(this.enemy);this.bounds(this.enemy);retreats++;
      }
      // Desvio legivel e limitado; o inimigo nao ganha invulnerabilidade eterna.
      const projectile=(this.projectiles||[]).find(p=>p.from==='player'&&p.life>.1 && Math.hypot(p.x-this.enemy.x,p.y-this.enemy.y)<this.h*.20);
      if(projectile && (!this.v3560LastDodge || now-this.v3560LastDodge>(boss?2600:3700)) && this.enemy.inv<=0 && Math.random()<(boss?.48:.25)){
        const dx=projectile.vx,dy=projectile.vy,ll=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
        const side=(Math.floor(now/700)%2)?1:-1;
        this.enemy.x+=(-dy/ll)*this.h*.067*side;this.enemy.y+=(dx/ll)*this.h*.067*side;
        this.bounds(this.enemy);this.collideRocks(this.enemy);
        this.v3560LastDodge=now;dodges++;this.particlesAt(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y,'#adddea',5,42);
      }
   }
   return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560AIDiagnostics=()=>({decisions,dodges,retreats,cooldown:engine?.enemyAttackCD,enemy:foe()?.id});
})();

/* V35.60 — contato corporal: recuo temporario e poeira de impacto sem alterar efeitos nomeados. */
(function(){
 const oldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget;
 const oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let impacts=0;
 BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(who,type,power){
   const before=who==='enemy'?foe()?.hp:current()?.hp;
   const result=oldHit.call(this,who,type,power);
   const after=who==='enemy'?foe()?.hp:current()?.hp;
   if(before!=null&&after!=null&&before>after && ['normal','fighting'].includes(type)){
      const target=who==='enemy'?this.enemy:this.player;
      this.v3560Contact||(this.v3560Contact=[]);
      this.v3560Contact.push({x:target.x,y:target.y-this.h*.12,at:performance.now(),duration:250});
      this.v3560Contact=this.v3560Contact.slice(-12);
      if(target){target.flash=Math.max(target.flash||0,.13);}
      impacts++;
   }
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=oldDraw.call(this,now);
   if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const c=this.ctx;
   this.v3560Contact=(this.v3560Contact||[]).filter(v=>now-v.at<v.duration);
   c.save();
   for(const fx of this.v3560Contact){
     const t=Math.max(0,Math.min(1,(now-fx.at)/fx.duration)),a=(1-t)*.75;
     c.globalAlpha=a;c.lineWidth=1.9;
     for(let i=0;i<5;i++){
       const ang=i*Math.PI*2/5+fx.at*.001,rad=(9+t*15)*(this.h/560);
       c.strokeStyle=i%2?'#fff0c7':'#ceac85';c.beginPath();
       c.moveTo(fx.x+Math.cos(ang)*rad*.65,fx.y+Math.sin(ang)*rad*.48);
       c.lineTo(fx.x+Math.cos(ang)*rad,fx.y+Math.sin(ang)*rad*.75);c.stroke();
     }
   }
   c.restore();return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560ContactDiagnostics=()=>({impacts,active:engine?.v3560Contact?.length||0});
})();

/* V35.60 — terreno interativo: clima visivel e efeitos de movimento/calor graduais. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update,oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let heatTicks=0,iceSlips=0;
 function weather(){return String(battle?.v32Weather||'clear').toLowerCase();}
 function isVolcano(){return weather()==='volcano'||(save.gym===6 && /vulc[aã]o|blaine/i.test((GYMS[6]?.name||'')+' '+(battle?.label||'')));}
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const active=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused,py=active?this.player?.y:0,px=active?this.player?.x:0;
   const result=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!active||!battle?.active)return result;
   const state=weather();
   if(state==='snow'||state==='hail'){
      // Solo gelado: velocidade reduzida cerca de 8%, sem mexer na esquiva.
      const changed=Math.hypot(this.player.x-px,this.player.y-py);
      if(changed>0.1){this.player.x=px+(this.player.x-px)*.92;this.player.y=py+(this.player.y-py)*.92;iceSlips++;}
   }
   if(isVolcano() && battle.v32Mode!=='lab'){
      if(!this.v3560HeatNext)this.v3560HeatNext=now+6000;
      if(now>=this.v3560HeatNext){this.v3560HeatNext=now+6000;heatTicks++;
        const p=current(),e=foe();
        for(const m of [p,e]){if(!m||m.hp<=1)continue;const d=D[m.id];if(d?.type==='fire'||d?.type2==='fire')continue;
          m.hp=Math.max(1,m.hp-Math.max(1,Math.floor(m.maxHp*.012)));
        }
        this.particlesAt(this.w*.5,this.h*.72,'#ffae58',12,38);
        log('🔥 Calor da lava: pequena perda de PV para tipos sem resistência.');
      }
   }else this.v3560HeatNext=0;
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const result=oldDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return result;
   const st=weather(),c=this.ctx,w=this.w,h=this.h;
   if(st==='clear')return result;
   c.save();
   // Particulas animadas discretas, criadas em Canvas (sem PNG estatico).
   if(st==='rain'||st==='storm'){
     c.lineWidth=1;c.strokeStyle='rgba(185,223,250,.23)';
     for(let i=0;i<16;i++){const x=((i*97+now*.15)%(w+40))-20,y=((i*71+now*.31)%(h*.63))+h*.28;
       c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y);c.lineTo(x-3,y+12);c.stroke();}
   }else if(st==='snow'||st==='hail'){
     c.fillStyle='rgba(232,248,255,.47)';for(let i=0;i<17;i++){const x=(i*73+now*.015*(1+i%3))%w,y=(i*43+now*.023)%h;c.beginPath();c.arc(x,y,1.2+(i%2),0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}
   }else if(isVolcano()){
     c.fillStyle='rgba(255,122,43,.27)';for(let i=0;i<9;i++){const x=(i*101+now*.004)%w,y=h*.9-(i*32+now*.013)%(h*.39);c.fillRect(x,y,2,3);}
   }
   c.restore();return result;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3560ArenaDiagnostics=()=>({weather:weather(),volcano:isVolcano(),heatTicks,iceSlips,breakableRocks:engine?.rocks?.filter(r=>r.hp>0).length||0});

/* V35.62: mudanças ambientais e regras de contato/status; renderizadores aprovados intactos. */

 const typeOf=m=>D[m?.id]?.type||'normal';
 function terrain(){

   if(['rain','storm'].includes(weather))return 'water';
   if(['sand','snow','hail'].includes(weather))return 'rock';
   if(weather==='fog')return 'ghost';
   const t=String(GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,GYMS.length-1)]?.type||'normal').toLowerCase();
   return ['grass','electric','rock','ground','water','ghost','dark'].includes(t)?({ground:'rock',dark:'ghost'}[t]||t):'normal';
 }
 const info={ticks:0,poisonTicks:0,blockedWhileSleeping:0,paralysisDelays:0,contactMisses:0,contactHits:0};
 function conditionList(engine,side){return engine?.v25?.stats?.[side]?.conditions||[];}
 function motilityFactor(engine,side){

 }
 function note(engine,actor,label,color){
   if(typeof engine.v25Popup==='function')engine.v25Popup(actor.x,actor.y-engine.h*.22,label,color);
 }
 // Alcance verdadeiro apenas para movimentos básicos de contato. Não toca em golpes assinados.
 function isBasicContact(move){const n=String(move?.name||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase();return /^(investida|arranhao|tackle|scratch)$/.test(n);}
 BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
   const move=battle?.active&&current()?skillSet(current())?.[i]:null;
   if(move&&isBasicContact(move)&&this.player&&this.enemy){
     const dist=Math.hypot(this.player.x-this.enemy.x,this.player.y-this.enemy.y);
     const reach=Math.max(62,this.h*.27); // investimento de movimento curto; sem atingir do outro lado.
     if(dist>reach){info.contactMisses++;note(this,this.player,'APROXIME-SE','#ffdcae');return false;}
   }
   // Dormência e paralisia do jogador afetam também ações, em vez de serem só etiquetas.

   const result=earlierHit.call(this,side,type,power);

   if(before>after&&source&&target&&['normal','fighting'].includes(type)){
     // Recuo curto e físico (não altera sprites de ataque).

 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const active=!!battle?.active&&!battle.paused;
   const pre=active?{pX:this.player.x,pY:this.player.y,eX:this.enemy.x,eY:this.enemy.y}:null;
   const result=earlierUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
   if(!active||!battle?.active||!this.player||!this.enemy)return result;
   const sideP=conditionList(this,'player'),sideE=conditionList(this,'enemy');
   const pm=motilityFactor(this,'player'),em=motilityFactor(this,'enemy');
   if(pm<1){this.player.x=pre.pX+(this.player.x-pre.pX)*pm;this.player.y=pre.pY+(this.player.y-pre.pY)*pm;this.bounds(this.player);}
   if(em<1){this.enemy.x=pre.eX+(this.enemy.x-pre.eX)*em;this.enemy.y=pre.eY+(this.enemy.y-pre.eY)*em;this.bounds(this.enemy);}
   if(sideE.includes('sleep')||sideE.includes('freeze')){
     // O turno de preparação não pode chegar a 0 enquanto dorme.
     this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.36,this.enemyAttackCD||0);
     if(this.telegraph?.from==='enemy')this.telegraph=null;
   }
   if(sideE.includes('paralysis')&& now>(this.v3562ParaEnemy||0)){
     this.v3562ParaEnemy=now+1800;
     if(Math.random()<.22){this.enemyAttackCD=Math.max(.55,this.enemyAttackCD||0);info.paralysisDelays++;note(this,this.enemy,'PARALISADO','#ffeb91');}
   }
   // Não duplicar veneno, queimadura ou sementes: já possuem tick próprio na base.
   const tile=terrain();this.v3562Terrain=tile;
   if(!this.v3562GroundTick)this.v3562GroundTick=now+3500;
   if(now>=this.v3562GroundTick){
     this.v3562GroundTick=now+3500;info.ticks++;
     if(tile==='grass'){
       for(const m of [current(),foe()])if(m?.hp>0&&m.hp<m.maxHp && typeOf(m)==='grass')m.hp=Math.min(m.maxHp,m.hp+Math.max(1,Math.round(m.maxHp*.009)));
     }
     if(tile==='electric'){
       for(const [side,m,a] of [['player',current(),this.player],['enemy',foe(),this.enemy]]){
         const st=conditionList(this,side);if(typeOf(m)==='electric'&&st.includes('paralysis')){
           this.v25.stats[side].conditions=st.filter(x=>x!=='paralysis');note(this,a,'ELETRICIDADE ABSORVIDA','#ffec9b');
         }
       }
     }
   }
   return result;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const res=earlierDraw.call(this,now);if(!battle?.active||!this.ctx)return res;
   const c=this.ctx,w=this.w,h=this.h,t=this.v3562Terrain||terrain();

   c.save();c.lineWidth=1.1;
   for(let i=0;i<count;i++){
     const x=(.13+i*.104)*w, y=(.78+Math.sin(i*3.4)*.13)*h,phase=now*.0008+i*1.9;
     if(t==='grass'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(124,220,120,.27)';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x,y+3);c.quadraticCurveTo(x-5+Math.sin(phase)*4,y-6,x+Math.cos(phase)*4,y-12);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='water'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(156,225,248,.24)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x,y,8+Math.sin(phase)*2,3.8,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='electric'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(250,227,116,.24)';const s=Math.sin(phase)*3;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-4,y-2);c.lineTo(x+s,y+1);c.lineTo(x+4,y-2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='rock'){
       c.strokeStyle='rgba(185,151,114,.19)';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(x-6,y);c.lineTo(x-2,y-3);c.lineTo(x+2,y+1);c.lineTo(x+6,y-2);c.stroke();
     }else if(t==='ghost'){
       c.fillStyle='rgba(149,125,202,.10)';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(x+Math.cos(phase)*3,y-8,9,3,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
     }
   }
   c.restore();return res;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3562TerrainDiagnostics=()=>({terrain:engine?.v3562Terrain||terrain(),...info,conditions:engine?.v25?.stats?.enemy?.conditions||[],protected:window.PokemonTorreGolpesProtegidos?.total||25});
})();

/* V35.62: dois golpes iniciais de Planta e ataques genéricos inimigos em Canvas 2D. */
(function(){
 'use strict';
 const oldUse=BattleEngine.prototype.useMove;
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update;
 const oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 const oldProjectile=BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile;
 const norm=s=>String(s||'').normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g,'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g,'');
 const cap=(x,a,b)=>Math.min(b,Math.max(a,x));
 let vines=0,drains=0,enemyFrames=0,healedTotal=0;
 function curve(c,x,y,tx,ty,shift,phase){
   const dx=tx-x,dy=ty-y,len=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1,nx=-dy/len,ny=dx/len;
   c.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<=14;j++){
      const q=j/14,wiggle=Math.sin(q*9.4+phase)*(4+shift)*Math.sin(Math.PI*q),off=(shift+wiggle);
      const px=x+dx*q+nx*off,py=y+dy*q+ny*off*.55;
      if(j===0)c.moveTo(px,py);else c.lineTo(px,py);
   }
 }
 BattleEngine.prototype.useMove=function(i){
   const s=battle?.active&&current()?skillSet(current())?.[i]:null,key=norm(s?.name);
   if(!s||!['chicotedevinha','vinewhip','absorver','absorb'].includes(key))return oldUse.call(this,i);
   const now=performance.now();if(battle.paused||current().hp<=0||(cooldowns[i]||0)>now||battle.energy<(s.cost||0))return false;
   battle.energy-=(s.cost||0);cooldowns[i]=now+(s.cd||1750);
   this.attackActs.player=this.time+.35;
   const kind=['chicotedevinha','vinewhip'].includes(key)?'vine':'drain';
   const fx={kind,at:now,hit:now+(kind==='vine'?230:290),end:now+(kind==='vine'?640:950),power:s.power,done:false,healed:false,from:{x:this.player.x,y:this.player.y-this.h*.10},to:{x:this.enemy.x,y:this.enemy.y-this.h*.11},target:foe()};
   (this.v3562PlantFx||(this.v3562PlantFx=[])).push(fx);
   if(kind==='vine')vines++;else drains++;
   this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.11,'#b9ff92',8,42);
   log(D[current().id].name+' usou '+s.name+'!');playSound('move');return true;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
   const r=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now),list=this.v3562PlantFx||[];
   if(!battle?.active){list.length=0;return r;}
   for(let i=list.length-1;i>=0;i--){
     const fx=list[i];
     if(!fx.done&&now>=fx.hit){
       const before=fx.target?.hp??0;
       if(foe()===fx.target)this.hitTarget('enemy','grass',fx.power);
       const loss=Math.max(0,before-(fx.target?.hp??before));fx.loss=loss;
       fx.done=true;
       if(fx.kind==='drain'){
         const own=current();const hp=own?Math.min(own.maxHp-own.hp,Math.ceil(loss*.5)):0;
         fx.healAmount=Math.max(0,hp);fx.healTime=now+190;
       }
       if(fx.kind==='vine')this.particlesAt(fx.to.x,fx.to.y,'#b8f8a4',10,52);
     }
     if(fx.kind==='drain'&&fx.done&&!fx.healed&&now>=(fx.healTime||Infinity)){
       fx.healed=true;
       if(fx.healAmount&&current()){current().hp=Math.min(current().maxHp,current().hp+fx.healAmount);healedTotal+=fx.healAmount;
         this.particlesAt(this.player.x,this.player.y-this.h*.1,'#c8ff8c',13,52);
         log(D[current().id].name+' absorveu '+fx.healAmount+' PV!');}
     }
     if(now>fx.end)list.splice(i,1);
   }
   return r;
 };
 // Projéteis inimigos usam traços vetoriais e formas sem texturas quadradas.
 BattleEngine.prototype.drawProjectile=function(p){
   if(p?.from!=='enemy')return oldProjectile.call(this,p);
   const c=this.ctx,type=p.type||'normal',r=Math.max(5,p.r||5),x=p.x,y=p.y,ang=Math.atan2(p.vy||0,p.vx||1);
   const pts=p.tail?.length?p.tail:[{x:x-(p.vx||0)*.03,y:y-(p.vy||0)*.03},{x,y}];
   c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
   const path=(color,w,a)=>{c.globalAlpha=a;c.strokeStyle=color;c.lineWidth=w;c.beginPath();pts.forEach((pt,i)=>i?c.lineTo(pt.x,pt.y):c.moveTo(pt.x,pt.y));c.stroke();};
   if(type==='electric'){
     const a=pts[0];c.strokeStyle='#ffe87c';c.lineWidth=2.8;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(a.x,a.y);const n=6;
     for(let i=1;i<n;i++){const t=i/n;c.lineTo(a.x+(x-a.x)*t+(i%2?4:-4),a.y+(y-a.y)*t+(i%2?-3:3));}c.lineTo(x,y);c.stroke();
     path('#fffad0',.9,.90);
   }else if(type==='grass'){
     path('#428c50',4,.70);path('#befa94',1.4,.84);
   }else if(type==='water'){
     path('#5bc4ea',4.5,.72);path('#d0f8ff',1.6,.9);
   }else if(type==='fire'){
     path('#e97942',5,.55);path('#ffe8a4',1.5,.88);
   }else{path(TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#abd3db',3.5,.65);path('#f2f6fc',1.2,.65);}
   c.translate(x,y);c.rotate(ang);c.globalAlpha=.95;
   if(type==='grass'){

     c.strokeStyle='#ebffd4';c.lineWidth=1.1;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,0);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else if(type==='fire'){

     c.fillStyle='#f66b37';c.beginPath();c.ellipse(-r*.08,r*.14,r*.44,r*.5,0,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
   }else if(type==='water'){
     c.fillStyle='#9cecff';c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r*.55,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,-r*1.2,r*.82,0);c.quadraticCurveTo(0,r,-r*.55,0);c.fill();
   }else if(type==='electric'){
     c.strokeStyle='#fff3ae';c.lineWidth=2.5;c.beginPath();c.moveTo(-r,-r*.18);c.lineTo(-r*.08,-r*.5);c.lineTo(-r*.22,r*.08);c.lineTo(r*.3,-r*.05);c.lineTo(0,r*.75);c.lineTo(r,0);c.stroke();
   }else{
     c.fillStyle=TYPE_COLOR[type]||'#d3e9ee';c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.80,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
     c.strokeStyle='#fff8';c.lineWidth=1.2;c.beginPath();c.arc(0,0,r*.46,0,Math.PI*2);c.stroke();
   }
   c.restore();enemyFrames++;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){
   const ret=oldDraw.call(this,now),list=this.v3562PlantFx||[];if(!battle?.active||!list.length||!this.ctx)return ret;
   const c=this.ctx;
   c.save();c.lineCap='round';c.lineJoin='round';
   for(const fx of list){
     const tt=cap((now-fx.at)/Math.max(1,fx.end-fx.at),0,1);
     const sx=fx.from.x,sy=fx.from.y,tx=fx.to.x,ty=fx.to.y;
     if(fx.kind==='vine'){
       const growth=cap((now-fx.at)/(fx.hit-fx.at),0,1), retract=cap((now-fx.hit)/(fx.end-fx.hit),0,1);
       const progress=Math.max(0,growth*(1-retract*.97));
       const ex=sx+(tx-sx)*progress,ey=sy+(ty-sy)*progress;
       for(const s of [-1,1]){
         c.globalAlpha=.92*(1-retract*.68);c.strokeStyle='#307b38';c.lineWidth=5.5;c.beginPath();curve(c,sx,sy,ex,ey,s*4,now*.016+s);c.stroke();
         c.strokeStyle='#a4f583';c.lineWidth=2;c.beginPath();curve(c,sx,sy,ex,ey,s*4,now*.016+s);c.stroke();
       }
       if(!fx.done){c.fillStyle='#e0ffb6';c.globalAlpha=.70;c.beginPath();c.arc(ex,ey,3.4,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();}
     }else{
       const start=fx.done?fx.hit:fx.at, travel=cap((now-start)/(fx.end-start),0,1);
       const vx=fx.done?tx:sx,vy=fx.done?ty:sy,wx=fx.done?sx:tx,wy=fx.done?sy:ty;
       c.globalAlpha=.65*(1-tt*.42);c.strokeStyle='#7bcf77';c.lineWidth=2.4;c.beginPath();curve(c,tx,ty,sx,sy,0,now*.01);c.stroke();
       for(let k=0;k<9;k++){
         const t=cap(travel+(k-4)*.075,0,1),xx=vx+(wx-vx)*t,yy=vy+(wy-vy)*t+Math.sin(k*1.2+now*.019)*5;
         c.globalAlpha=.28+.56*(1-t*.35);c.fillStyle=k%2?'#b9ff8e':'#62c369';c.beginPath();c.arc(xx,yy,2.3+(k%3)*.7,0,Math.PI*2);c.fill();
       }
     }
   }
   c.restore();return ret;
 };
 window.PokemonTorreV3562VisualDiagnostics=()=>({vines,drains,enemyFrames,healedTotal,active:engine?.v3562PlantFx?.map(x=>x.kind)||[]});
})();

/* V35.63 — IA de chefes por perfil e Clash de contato sem alterar visuais dos golpes aprovados. */
(function(){
 const oldUpdate=BattleEngine.prototype.update,oldHit=BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget,oldDraw=BattleEngine.prototype.draw;
 let phaseEvents=0,clashes=0,brainTicks=0;
 const personas=[['brock','guardiao'],['misty','agil'],['lt. surge','eletrico'],['erika','distancia'],['koga','esquiva'],['sabrina','controle'],['blaine','agressivo'],['giovanni','guardiao'],['blue','adaptativo'],['bruno','agressivo'],['lorelei','distancia'],['agatha','esquiva'],['lance','agil']];
 function bossInfo(){if(!battle?.active||battle.wild)return null;const label=String(battle.label||'').toLowerCase(),gym=String(GYMS[Math.min(save.gym,12)]?.leader||'').toLowerCase();
  const leader=personas.find(([name])=>label.includes(name)||gym.includes(name)&&/l[ií]der|chefe|rival|blue/i.test(label));
  const flag=/chefe|campe[aã]o|l[ií]der|blue|rival|final/i.test(label)||(battle.v32Mode==='tower'&&battle.v32Floor%5===0);
  return flag?{style:leader?.[1]||'adaptativo',label:leader?.[0]||'chefe'}:null;
 }
 function contactClash(engine,side,type){
  if(!['normal','fighting','bug','dark','steel'].includes(type)||!engine.player||!engine.enemy||!battle?.active)return false;
  const dist=Math.hypot(engine.player.x-engine.enemy.x,engine.player.y-engine.enemy.y);
  const both=(engine.attackActs?.player||0)>engine.time&&(engine.attackActs?.enemy||0)>engine.time;
  return both&&dist<Math.max(56,engine.h*.23)&&(performance.now()-(engine.v3563ClashLast||0))>2400;
 }
 BattleEngine.prototype.hitTarget=function(side,type,power){
  if(contactClash(this,side,type)){
   const now=performance.now(),rng=Math.random();
   this.v3563ClashLast=now;
   this.v3563Clash={at:now,until:now+420,x:(this.player.x+this.enemy.x)/2,y:(this.player.y+this.enemy.y)/2-this.h*.08};
   clashes++;
   const dx=this.enemy.x-this.player.x,dy=this.enemy.y-this.player.y,l=Math.hypot(dx,dy)||1;
   const shift=Math.min(14,this.h*.026);
   this.enemy.x+=dx/l*shift;this.enemy.y+=dy/l*shift;
   this.player.x-=dx/l*shift*.55;this.player.y-=dy/l*shift*.55;
   this.bounds(this.enemy);this.bounds(this.player);
   this.particlesAt(this.v3563Clash.x,this.v3563Clash.y,'#fff0bc',12,95);
   if(typeof this.v25Popup==='function')this.v25Popup(this.v3563Clash.x,this.v3563Clash.y-this.h*.05,'CLASH!','#ffe1a3');
   power=power*.72; // choque reduz impacto de ambos, não modifica sprite nem catálogo
  }
  return oldHit.call(this,side,type,power);
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.update=function(dt,now){
  const wasActive=battle?.active;const res=oldUpdate.call(this,dt,now);
  if(!wasActive||!battle?.active||battle.paused||!this.enemy||!this.player)return res;
  const b=bossInfo();if(!b)return res;
  const hp=foe()?.hp||0,max=foe()?.maxHp||1,phase=hp/max<=.5?2:1;
  if(this.v3563BossId!==foe()){this.v3563BossId=foe();this.v3563BossPhase=1;this.v3563BrainAt=0;}
  if(phase===2&&this.v3563BossPhase!==2){this.v3563BossPhase=2;phaseEvents++;this.enemy.focus=Math.max(this.enemy.focus||0,.8);if(typeof this.v25Popup==='function')this.v25Popup(this.enemy.x,this.enemy.y-this.h*.24,'FASE 2 · ESTRATÉGIA','#ffe2a2');}
  if(now<(this.v3563BrainAt||0))return res;
  this.v3563BrainAt=now+(phase===2?900:1400);brainTicks++;
  const e=this.enemy,p=this.player,d=Math.hypot(e.x-p.x,e.y-p.y)||1,nx=(e.x-p.x)/d,ny=(e.y-p.y)/d,speed=this.h*(phase===2?.052:.036);
  if(b.style==='guardiao'){
    if(d<this.h*.28){e.x+=nx*speed;e.y+=ny*speed;}
    e.guard=Math.max(e.guard||0,phase===2?.35:.18);
  }else if(b.style==='agil'||b.style==='esquiva'){
    const sg=Math.sin(now*.003+e.x*.02)>0?1:-1;
    e.x+=-ny*speed*sg;e.y+=nx*speed*sg;
  }else if(b.style==='distancia'||b.style==='controle'){
    if(d<this.h*.32){e.x+=nx*speed;e.y+=ny*speed;}else if(d>this.h*.50){e.x-=nx*speed*.55;e.y-=ny*speed*.55;}
  }else if(b.style==='agressivo'){
    if(d>this.h*.16){e.x-=nx*speed*1.30;e.y-=ny*speed*1.30;}
  }else{
    if(d<this.h*.23){e.x+=nx*speed*.72;e.y+=ny*speed*.72;}
    else if(d>this.h*.43){e.x-=nx*speed*.70;e.y-=ny*speed*.70;}
    else{e.x-=ny*speed*.6;e.y+=nx*speed*.6;}
  }
  this.bounds(e);this.collideRocks(e);

  return res;
 };
 BattleEngine.prototype.draw=function(now){const res=oldDraw.call(this,now);const fx=this.v3563Clash;

  const c=this.ctx,p=Math.min(1,
